LESSON: TAWAKKUL (RELIANCE ON ALLAH)

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.3: Tawakkul (Reliance on Allah)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Tawakkul (Reliance on Allah), part of Pillars of Iman in Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: which Muslims can practise tawakkul in their daily life. 1. How can a Muslim show reliance on Allah? 2. Why is tawakkul important to a Muslim?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
